title: Canonical integral comparisons for exceptional base change
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Use the ordinary derived coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], their uniformly constructible finite-Tor categories [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and the section-normalized geometric calculus [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. Assume ell is invertible in every residue field of the schemes. For a Cartesian square of schemes $fu=vf'$ with a fixed compactification $c$ of $f$, fix the corresponding restricted compact-support functors, right adjoints and adjunctions [det-sp-tower-gluing]. Define the simultaneous integral comparison datum as follows. For each of the four schemes, record completed reduction, its fully faithful restriction, normalized reduction/total-limit adjunction and invertible constructible unit [det-sp-normalized-equivalence], together with the canonical cofinal strict comparison from uniformizer towers to ell-power towers. For each vertical compactification record the reconstruction package of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection] and [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower], including its ordinary-generator and derived-composition normalized scalar comparison. On the derived-complete integral constructible categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], record the compact-support right adjoints and their adjunctions, their total-limit descriptions and reduction comparisons, requiring the reduction of each counit to be precisely the corresponding tower counit. For each horizontal completed pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], record its total-limit and reduction comparisons. Fix the latter as the composite of the canonical integral pullback reconstruction counit and the derived cofinal inverse-image mate of the identity on direct-image sections. Require all support comparisons to equal the reconstruction package's fixed comparisons, and all right-adjoint and pullback comparisons to equal reduction of the total-limit comparison followed by the reconstruction counit. Quasi-compactness of the vertical maps is a field of this datum. This is a definition of the comparisons used in exceptional base change, with no existence or invertibility assertion about the exceptional base-change mate. The strict cofinal reduction model is that of [def-sp-twisted-pullback-reduction-data], the compactification comparison package is [def-sp-integral-reconstruction-comparison-data], and the K-flat-normalized completed pullback comparison is [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The square-specific tower restriction and adjunction data and horizontal functors are the existing definitions of [def-sp-tower-mate-data].
